title: CMOS voltage converter (charge pump: positive supply to negative)

sources.document: Intersil ICL7660, ICL7660A CMOS Voltage Converters datasheet FN3072 Rev.7.00 (October 5, 2010)

pins.name: CAPPLUS
pins.text: CAP+, plus side of the charge-pump capacitor

pins.name: CAPMINUS
pins.text: CAP-, minus side of the charge-pump capacitor

pins.name: VOUT
pins.text: negative output, about -V+ (needs a reservoir capacitor)

pins.name: LV
pins.text: low-voltage pin: to GND below 3.5 V supply; left open from 3.5 V to 10 V

pins.name: OSC
pins.text: oscillator: a capacitor here lowers the frequency, or it can be driven by an outside clock

functions.text: With two outside capacitors (charge pump on CAP+/CAP-, reservoir on VOUT) the output is the supply turned negative: V+ in gives about -V+ out. The internal oscillator runs at about 10 kHz at 5 V with nothing on OSC (page 1).

electrical.notes: V+ 5 V, 25 C: supply current 170 typ / 500 max uA; output source resistance 55 typ / 100 max ohm at 20 mA; oscillator 10 kHz typ; power efficiency 98% typ; voltage conversion efficiency 99.9% typ; supply 10.5 V absolute maximum (page 3).

notes: Figures are the ICL7660 column; the ICL7660A goes to 12 V.

behaviour.reason: voltage converter (charge pump): an analog power part with no logic function.
